title: Flux 2 Klein 4B Base Edit LoRA
description: Image-to-image editing with LoRA support for FLUX.2 [klein] 4B Base from Black Forest Labs. Specialized style transfer and domain-specific modifications.

pricing.text: Requests cost $0.016 per megapixel of input and output. Input images will be resized to 1MP. For example, a 1024x1024 generation with 512*512 size image input will cost 0.032 (1 MP input + 1 MP output, each costing 0.016).

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The prompt to edit the image.

inputs.name: negative_prompt
inputs.tooltip: Negative prompt for classifier-free guidance. Describes what to avoid in the image. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The seed to use for the generation. If not provided, a random seed will be used. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: num_inference_steps
inputs.tooltip: The number of inference steps to perform.

inputs.name: image_size
inputs.tooltip: The size of the generated image. If not provided, uses the input image size. 'custom' uses the width and height below.

inputs.name: num_images
inputs.tooltip: The number of images to generate.

inputs.name: acceleration
inputs.tooltip: The acceleration level to use for image generation.

inputs.name: enable_safety_checker
inputs.tooltip: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked, and images flagged as unsafe are returned as black images.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: image
inputs.tooltip: The URLs of the images for editing. A maximum of 4 images are allowed. Each socket may carry a batch; they are sent in socket order (the first picture of socket 1 is number 1).

inputs.name: loras
inputs.tooltip: List of LoRA weights to apply (maximum 3). JSON. Empty leaves it out.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
